description: Multi-Modal Intelligent Traffic Signal Systems Signal Plans for Roadside Equipment is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "MMITSS Prototype Development and Impacts Assessment Team. (2015). Multi-Modal Intelligent Traffic Signal Systems Signal Plans for Roadside Equipment. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504491". Data were collected during the Multi-Modal Intelligent Transportation Signal Systems (MMITSS) study. MMITSS is a next-generation traffic signal system that seeks to provide a traffic information framework to service all modes of transportation.The Signal Plans for Roadside Equipment (RSE) data contains the basics of a Signal Phase and Timing (SPAT) message. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 22 columns, among them Timeremaining_Phase_Ring1, PhaseCheck1, Duration_Indication_MinorStreet, CumulativeTime2, Duration_Indication_MajorStreet, CumulativeTime1 . The portal shows 2017-09-12 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
